_readme: The people tools/blender/make_people.py builds from MakeHuman (CC0). Each: MakeHuman targets (path under makehuman/data/targets, no extension) and their weights, mixed onto the base mesh; then fitted to our skeleton and body envelope. Output: assets/people/<id>.glb (+ .json with the joints it was fitted to).

outlaw.note: A hard man in his late thirties: lean, wiry, a little weathered.
